disposition: documented research; proposed architecture and experiment
source_date_convention: date of inspected version/publication; null for undated live docs

discovery.alternate_discovery: Two workstreams performed one brief alternate-search batch each before retrieval constraints were clarified. Substantive claims checked with direct primary reads.

sources.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
sources.scope_and_limit: Believable social behavior; finite simulation, seeded ambition, not compounding capability.

sources.title: Project Sid / PIANO
sources.scope_and_limit: Concurrency and coherent execution; cultural scale differs from collective problem-solving.

sources.title: Concordia
sources.scope_and_limit: Separate agent observations and proposed actions from world authority; no learning benchmark.

sources.title: GovSim: Cooperate or Collapse
sources.scope_and_limit: Consequential resource cooperation; bounded game outcomes, not cumulative skill learning.

sources.title: GovSim reproduction and heterogeneous-agent extension
sources.scope_and_limit: Composition and timing matter; small samples and run-count ambiguity constrain confidence.

sources.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
sources.scope_and_limit: Executable skill library and bounded transfer; domain-specific interface and small transfer samples.

sources.title: LongMemEval
sources.scope_and_limit: Indexing, retrieval and reading are separate; conversational QA does not prove procedural learning.

sources.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
sources.scope_and_limit: Associative links and evolving derived memory; category-level regressions remain relevant.

sources.title: Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents
sources.scope_and_limit: Scope-first shared experience with personal preferences separated; source quality and coverage limit transfer.

sources.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
sources.scope_and_limit: Task-level skills can harm; subtask procedures help on average in tested conditions, not universally.

sources.title: Towards a Science of Scaling Agent Systems
sources.scope_and_limit: 260 configurations, six benchmarks; task-dependent effects and limited predictive/statistical confidence.

sources.title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
sources.scope_and_limit: 1600+ traces, seven frameworks, 14 failure modes; differing tasks prevent framework ranking.

sources.title: More Agents Is All You Need
sources.scope_and_limit: Sampling and aggregation form a baseline; they do not require persistent shared learning.

sources.title: Should we be going MAD? A Look at Multi-Agent Debate Strategies for LLMs
sources.scope_and_limit: Debate and forced disagreement have mixed effects in mostly older multiple-choice settings.

sources.title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP)
sources.scope_and_limit: Fixed-model scaffold improvement with selected transfer; weak-model degradation and selection costs matter.

sources.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
sources.scope_and_limit: Diverse agent archive, benchmark improvements and transfer; finite coding domain, cost and grader manipulation limits.

sources.title: AlphaEvolve: A Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms
sources.read_depth: announcement and selected linked technical-report sections
sources.scope_and_limit: Generation/evaluation/program database; verified computable domains, not general social-world learning.

sources.title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET)
sources.scope_and_limit: Task-solution coevolution and cross-environment transfer in bipedal obstacle courses.

sources.title: OMNI-EPIC
sources.read_depth: abstract and official project/repository surfaces only
sources.scope_and_limit: Generated environment/reward code and interesting learnable tasks; full experimental protocol not reviewed.

sources.title: LangGraph persistence documentation
sources.scope_and_limit: Thread checkpoints differ from cross-thread stores; RAM savers do not survive restart. No intelligence experiment.
